<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Lists the open positions of one of your wallets, one item per position.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `polymarket.positions` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wallet (`wallet`) | one of your [wallets](/docs/guides/concepts/#wallets) | yes |  | Personal: sharing the workflow leaves it out. |
| Limit (`limit`) | whole number | no | `50` | Most positions to return. |
